name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
summary: At Anvilmar, riflemen need the ammunition Hegnar Rumbleshot is running short of. A courier abandoned a crate near the Grizzled Den after hungry wendigo drove him from the snowy wilds.

sections.title: A Courier's Flight
sections.body: Loslor Rudge at Steelgrill's Depot supplies tradesmen across Dun Morogh, but wildlife can disrupt his shipments. His latest crate of heavy ammunition never reached Hegnar Rumbleshot's roadside workshop. The courier was camping near the Grizzled Den cave system when local wendigo crossed his path. He fled for his life, leaving the crate behind in the snow.

sections.title: Powder and Shot
sections.body: Hegnar Rumbleshot runs a gun shop beside the main road leading away from Anvilmar. Ironforge riflemen, mountaineers, and dwarven mortar squads gather in the clearing outside his forge to sight their weapons and practice with live fire. Without regular shipments of powder and lead from suppliers like Loslor, the riflemen's marksmanship practice soon comes to a halt.

faq.q: Where was the ammo crate lost?
faq.answer: The courier abandoned Loslor Rudge's shipment while camping just outside the Grizzled Den, a wendigo-infested cave in the snowy hills southwest of Kharanos.
Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith with a weapon shop along the road near Anvilmar. He supplies powder, bullets, and firearms to mountaineers, hunters, and siege teams drilling nearby.

faq.q: Why was the courier chased off?
faq.answer: The courier camped near the Grizzled Den, home to savage, territorial wendigo that roam the hills southwest of Kharanos.

faq.q: Why is Hegnar Rumbleshot out of ammunition?
faq.answer: Dwarven riflemen and mortar teams use up powder and lead practicing target drills near Hegnar's shop, keeping demand for his ammunition high.
Loslor Rudge is a dwarven engineering supplier at Steelgrill's Depot who ships ammunition to Hegnar Rumbleshot.

faq.q: Does recovered ammunition spoil in the snow?
faq.answer: Dwarven munitions are traditionally packed in heavy, weather-sealed wooden crates to keep black powder dry and ready to burn, even in Dun Morogh's sub-zero blizzards.

angles.text: As a hunter in Coldridge, you know Hegnar's shop well. His fresh powder and shot help keep your rifle ready for the wilderness.
As a dwarf, you know that your craftsmanship depends on a steady supply line between Anvilmar's smithies and frontline gunsmiths like Rumbleshot.
As an engineer, you know dwarven firearms and mortars need finely milled powder and uniform shot. Rumbleshot's stock matters to local tinkerers and gunners.
